programs.title: Journeys in Japan
programs.desc: . Alfie Goodrich heads to dynamic Osaka to savor the food culture, the waterways that made the city a commercial hub, the architecture, and the wonderfully outgoing people who make the city so fun. Bill Sullivan, Kyle Card, Michael Keida, Dean Newcombe, James Lambiasi, Natsumi Nagaoka, Atsushi Takase, Yosuke Hosoi.
